title: Towards Knowledge-Grounded Counter Narrative Generation for Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality of knowledge-grounded counter-narratives generated in response to Islamophobic (in-domain) and Antisemitic (cross-domain) hate speech using automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, Novelty) and human evaluation (suitability, informativeness, coherence).
Evaluating zero-shot cross-domain generation of counter-narratives against misogynistic hate speech using automatic metrics and human evaluation.
Evaluating zero-shot cross-domain generation of counter-narratives against racist hate speech using automatic metrics and human evaluation.
Evaluating zero-shot cross-domain generation of counter-narratives against homophobic hate speech using automatic metrics and human evaluation.
